semiconductor_relevance: High — Allied Supreme specializes in fluoropolymer equipment and solutions that are critical for chemical delivery systems in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Allied Supreme Corp. provides high-purity fluoropolymer equipment and solutions tailored for the semiconductor and TFT-LCD industries. Their offerings include chemical dispense systems, lined tanks, and various piping solutions designed to meet stringent purity and reliability standards.

regional_presence.China: Allied Supreme has established a new factory in Jiaxing to enhance production capabilities and customer service.
